purpose: Teach: 乳児/遺骨/銃弾/勾留/留置/採血/病的/課さ

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、乳児への虐待事案を、警察、慎重に対応されますね
lines.en: In this case, the police are handling the infant abuse allegations with great care, aren't they.
lines.style: Hesitant, deferential start. Careful pace through the difficult subject, voice dropping respectfully near the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、戦災者の遺骨収集にもご協力されますね
lines.en: The police cooperate in recovering the remains of war victims as well.
lines.style: Calm professional confirmation. Even, measured delivery, quiet warmth surfacing on the word cooperate.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、現場から銃弾を、警察、回収されますね
lines.en: In this case, the police will be recovering the bullets from the scene, won't they.
lines.style: Studious, slightly quicker delivery. A questioning lift at the end, eager to have understood correctly.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の勾留期間を、警察、適正に管理されますね
lines.en: The police manage a suspect's detention period properly, strictly by the book.
lines.style: Flat procedural steadiness. Unhurried, each phrase placed precisely, mild emphasis on the word properly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、留置場の管理を、警察、徹底されますね
lines.en: In this case, the police are being thorough about how the holding cells are managed, aren't they.
lines.style: Careful, lowered tone. Slow deliberate pace, the confirming tag rising softly at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現場の被害者に採血、つまり採血検査を、警察、依頼されますね
lines.en: The police ask victims at the scene for blood samples — blood tests, that is.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact through the clarification. Even pace, a brief pause before the restated term for clarity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の病的虚言癖を、警察、慎重に判断されますね
lines.en: In this case, the police are weighing the suspect's pathological lying very carefully, aren't they.
lines.style: Quieter, weighing each word. Slow thoughtful delivery, trailing slightly on the final word.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、課された規制内で捜査を、警察、進められますね
lines.en: The police carry the investigation forward within the regulations imposed on them.
lines.style: Settled closing authority. Calm, even pace, finishing with quiet finality and a small exhale.
